cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Exactly as Planned
cards.instruction: Treat every exposed flaw, failed step, and unexpected consequence as proof that the scheme is unfolding by design.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Mum found the surprise-party invitations. Right on schedule.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You made me hide them in my sock drawer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. She had to feel she'd uncovered it herself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's cancelling the caterer. She hates surprises.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's her part of the plan: taking control. We surprise her with how completely we obey.

mechanism: A directs the group's interpretation so both discovery and Mum taking control count as stages A intended.
confusable: Unlike genuinely obeying another leader without comment, A claims authorship even of the loss of control.
comparison: Party cancellation and planned obedience differ from the escape-room leaderboard claim.
seedUse: The seed states A ordered hiding and A5 prescribes how we obey, giving the Stance a real supervisory relation to B.
